title: Deal Board
tagline: Back made-up companies. Read their signals. Learn when to hold and when to walk away.
intro: You have ₹1,00,000 of play money and 12 quarters. A quarter is three months.
Every quarter, one company pitches to you. Ask questions to see its real numbers, then invest or pass.
The game scores your judgement, not your profit. Every decision gets feedback on what went well and what to improve.
guardrail: Simulation with made-up numbers. Real life is different.
dragNote: Prices rose a little. Idle cash lost {{x}}.
